transcript: YAGA not dropping until 3:00am on AMC+ in New York is diabolical. I get it, it's midnight Pacific. That's 3:00am here. But like, I wanna watch the show at night, but I don't wanna wait until tomorrow night. So my options are stay up and watch it at 3:00am, go to sleep, wake up to watch it at 3:00am, go to sleep, wake up and watch it before work. But like, it doesn't feel like a morning show. Or don't watch till tomorrow night, which also doesn't feel right anyway. This is me complaining because I've heard spoilers have already started to drop for episode 3 and I don't wanna be spoiled. But I wanna watch it right now. Do I move to California for the next six weeks? Or Canada? I guess it'd be better.
